portrait_compositing.overlay_mode: All face marks are already curved/projected into full 512x512 transparent canvases; alpha composite at (0,0), do not warp twice. For other sizes scale entire overlay with base.
portrait_compositing.recolor_formula_srgb: out = plate*(1-mask/255) + team_rgb*(key_shading/255)*(mask/255); then source-over chest mark; then source-over cap mark
portrait_compositing.key_albedo: #FF0000; exact red in key_albedo PNG, illuminated red in photographic base
portrait_compositing.background: Opaque generated near-solid dark #20262e target, minor studio tonal variation
